status: Testable creative hypothesis, not measured customer segmentation
description: A bag-aware shopper who recognizes the Birkin silhouette, likes understated styling, and wants a price she can justify. She is skeptical of generic quality promises and wants to see the actual design and purchase conditions.
voice: Conversational peer showing a find: short contractions, clear everyday nouns, one concrete visual detail per breath. Curious and confident, with light enthusiasm and room for a practical objection.
exclude_assumptions: No invented age, race, income, geography, job, family, coastal lifestyle or ownership history.
No presumption that all shoppers want to look wealthy or fool others.
No gender policing, class shame, cheap-woman judgments or claim that people judge the viewer by her bag.
angle_fit: User-authorized Birkin-dupe concept. Contrast recognizable design and actual price through subjective styling judgment, with no assertion of identical manufacturing or affiliation.
naturalness_notes: Read aloud before approval. Break attribute stacks that cannot fit in one normal breath.
Avoid corporate phrases such as elevate your look, luxury redefined and curated for you.
Use spontaneous cadence without stuffing literally/obsessed into every sentence.
First-person preference is permissible; first-person use, purchase, compliments or testing require a real source.
